changes.oldValue: IWn.request rejects if electronBridge sender is absent or supplied signal already aborted, stores promise resolver by generated id, sends worker-request, and rejects/removes pending state on delivery failure. A supplied signal adds local reject plus worker-request-cancel; selected Yt supplies none.
changes.newValue: IWn.request returns a rejected Promise if electronBridge sender is absent or a supplied signal is already aborted. It inserts pending resolvers before invoking the sender. Rejection handled by the returned sender value’s .catch callback rejects and removes that pending entry. A synchronous sender invocation or .catch access/call error escapes this non-async request path without the selected rejection cleanup; the previously inserted entry is not removed there. A supplied signal adds local rejection and worker-request-cancel; selected Yt supplies none. The saved preload sender declaration is async, while actual external bridge receiver identity is unobserved.
